svg.title: Where the k₁ limits come from
svg.desc: Animated pupil diagram: the orders of a 1:1 grating slide outward as k1 falls from 1.0 to 0.28 under a sigma 0.7 fill and the image contrast beneath drops to zero at k1 = 0.29; a matched dipole then keeps two-beam contrast down to the 0.25 limit, where pole and order sit on opposite rims.
